A clear read would distinguish a top plane across the active rearward cut in matched views while holding this width and grasp. Confirmation in watched native timing is still needed.

issues.reason: The magnified F6 comparison shows an abrupt horizontal interruption beneath the waist across the armored thigh into adjacent tackle/diagonal strap. The candidate changes stop left of that break. The more visible upper rein reads through to its bit; the issue is the nearby strap/join and interrupted armor shading, separate from the improved tail or blade continuity. Observable repair is continuous local armor and strap paths without disturbing their surrounding pose.
